decks.notes: The deck focuses on efficiently ramping up mana through land-based interactions and utilizing Primaeval Titan to search for powerful lands to enhance the board state. The goal is to quickly assemble the Amulet of Vigor combo to generate explosive amounts of mana and bring out massive threats like Cultivator Colossus and Scapeshift. The deck can also win through alternate win conditions like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The key strategy is to carefully manage the sequencing of land drops and utilize multiple land tutors to set up for game-winning plays.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board while utilizing blink effects to generate value from enter-the-battlefield triggers. The deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board, as well as creatures like Flickerwisp and Boggart Trawler to repeatedly trigger powerful abilities like Ephemerate and Relic of Progenitus. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk to quickly close out the game.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing creatures with abilities such as haste and evasion to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes various spells and enchantments to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creature attacks and powerful spells, keeping the pressure on at all times and finishing the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast-paced strategy, utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge for direct damage, as well as Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for card advantage and early aggression. Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls provide additional creature support, while Static Prison helps control the board. With a mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to fuel Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch for a powerful win condition. The deck also includes various ways to protect the combo pieces, such as Spell Snare and Swan Song. Additionally, the inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional value and consistency to the deck. By efficiently using card draw and mana acceleration, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a lethal Grinding Station combo.

The main concept of this deck is to combine aggressive creatures with flickering effects to repeatedly generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can protect its creatures, remove threats, and trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities. This synergy is further enhanced by cards like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Boggart Trawler, which provide additional value when flickered. The deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent by deploying threats quickly and efficiently while disrupting their strategy through targeted removal and graveyard hate.

The main concept of this deck is to combine aggressive creatures with blink effects to repeatedly get value from enters-the-battlefield triggers. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also generating card advantage. The deck includes a mix of removal, hand disruption, and graveyard hate to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure while gaining incremental advantages through its blink synergies.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enter the battlefield (ETB) abilities to disrupt the opponent's board while also applying aggressive pressure. By blinking these creatures with cards like Ephemerate or Flickerwisp, you can repeatedly trigger their ETB effects for additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Fatal Push to deal with threats. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the board with aggressive creatures and disruption, while using blinking effects to maximize their impact and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, while also using combo pieces such as Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Grinding Station to generate additional value and potentially win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes various artifacts and cards that can be sacrificed to further fuel the graveyard recursion strategy. By combining these card synergies efficiently, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures that have powerful blink abilities to gain value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp with creatures such as Boggart Trawler and Solitude, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. Additionally, cards like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize help control the opponent's graveyard and hand, ensuring that the deck can maintain its tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate massive amounts of mana quickly. By leveraging cards like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift, the deck can search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and generate lethal amounts of damage in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Field and Urza's Saga also allow for additional ramp and land searching capabilities, creating a powerful engine that can overwhelm opponents in a short amount of time. The deck aims to combo off and win the game quickly before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on the strategy of ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and using cards like Talisman of Creativity and Talisman of Curiosity to accelerate the deployment of powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. It combines control elements such as Spell Snare and Consign to Memory to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing cards like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return for removal and board control. The inclusion of cards like Stock Up and Nulldrifter provide card advantage and ensure the player has answers to various threats. Through the Breach is used as a way to cheat Emrakul into play for a game-ending attack.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard, while also utilizing Tamiyo and Emry to draw cards and generate mana. The combo involves using Grinding Station and Emry to mill the opponent's deck, while Malevolent Rumble deals damage based on the cards in their graveyard. Mox Opal and Mox Amber provide additional mana acceleration, allowing for explosive turns where multiple spells can be cast in quick succession. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize red mana rituals and card draw spells to quickly build up mana and storm count, leading to a massive finisher with Ral, Monsoon Mage or Past in Flames. By chaining together multiple spells in a single turn, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive burst of damage or card advantage. The inclusion of Wish allows the deck to access sideboard cards for specific situations, adding versatility to the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard to generate value and eventually win the game. It includes a variety of cheap artifacts and cantrips to fill the graveyard quickly, as well as creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur key pieces. The deck aims to set up a combo involving Grinding Station, Thassa's Oracle, or Malevolent Rumble to either mill the opponent out or win through a powerful combo finish. The key strategy revolves around efficient casting, graveyard recursion, and careful sequencing of spells to outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast powerful spells and combo off with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and Grinding Station to generate value and win the game. It also includes key pieces like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to help fuel the combo and get the engine going. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt opponents while controlling the game until it can go off and win.
